The '''Ritual Chambers''' were a series of ancient rooms built under the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] long before the [[Great Galactic War]].

==Overview==
Located at the back wall of the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in the vicinity of the ruined [[Great Temple (Korriban)|Great Temple]], the Ritual Chambers were constructed by the ancient [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] before the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. When the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] returned to Korriban during the [[Jedi Civil War]] the constructed their [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] over the long forgotten chambers without ever realizing their presence. When the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] reopened the academy during the [[Great Galactic War]] [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Ragate]] helped to rediscover the chambers and reopen them after centuries of disuse.<ref name="TOR" />

Within the Ritual Chambers, the Academy conducted the [[Rite of blood and bone]], a test in which an [[Sith acolyte/Legends|aspiring Sith]] was tasked with retrieving a skull from the altar of bones and submerging it within the pool of blood. The ancient ritual preformed at the pool summoned a [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] known as the [[Bloodfiend]] which would attack and kill the acolyte should they prove unworthy and their skull would be added to the altar. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] an acolyte at the Academy conducted the ritual and slew the Bloodfiend, leaving its corpse to rot in the pool of blood.<ref name="TOR" />
